rq: joint identification of raw-language equivalence and latent intervention-target partition
result: AP001.1 is a valid conditional matching lemma, but A4-A6 either require target-indexed channel access that supplies target identity or are unavailable when targets are genuinely unknown. A6 exposes an injective surrogate of d(q), so AP001 is retained only as an instrumented oracle positive control. The remaining positive path requires a genuinely observable joint language/intervention law and comparison to multi-view identifiability results.
